events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to South Haven's pier. I'd rate it 2 of 4 (average).** It is the only pier with a recent average rating.
- **St. Joseph is second, rated 1 of 4 provisionally.** It has no pier report in four weeks, so this is a low-confidence guess.
- **Grand Haven and Muskegon are both rated 1 of 4 (below average).** Expect a few fish at most.
- **Fish glow spoons, spinners, or shrimp under a bobber** at South Haven, since those are what worked on the pier lately.

## Why

- South Haven's pier is the only one with a recent average rating: the Aug 27 report rated pier coho average on spinners, spoons, and shrimp under bobbers.
- Grand Haven and Muskegon piers have mostly been slow or below average, and the pier reports from Aug 13 and Aug 20 described slow or unsuccessful pier fishing.
- I'd expect St. Joseph to be decent this week, since its pier area had the most upwelling-favorable wind in the last three days of the week in the conditions summary, but I have no recent pier report there to confirm it.

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (newest is Aug 27, 6 days old)
- South Haven pier (Aug 27): coho, quality 2 (average). "Pier fishing was decent as well. Anglers were catching coho salmon and steelhead, using spinners and spoons, as well as shrimp fished under bobbers." No depth was given for the pier.
- Muskegon pier (Aug 27): quality 1 (below average). "Pier anglers caught a few salmon while casting glow spoons." Earlier pier reports were 0 on Aug 13 and Aug 6.
- Grand Haven pier (Aug 27): not rated. "Pier anglers caught salmon on alewives and while casting glow spoons." Earlier pier reports were 0 on Aug 20 and Aug 13.
- St. Joseph pier: the last pier report was Aug 6, quality 1 (below average), with "steelhead and the occasional Chinook salmon using shrimp." No St. Joseph pier report appeared on Aug 13, 20, or 27.
- Boats were doing better than the piers at Grand Haven (Aug 20, quality 3) and South Haven (Aug 6, quality 3), but those reports are older and are only background here.

**Conditions** (the tool returned a backtest summary of the week before Sept 2, not live data)
- Measured buoy surface water: St. Joseph 72 F, South Haven 70 F, Grand Haven and Muskegon 65 F (buoy 45161).
- Satellite surface water at the piers: St. Joseph 71 F (flat over the week), South Haven 70 F, Grand Haven 66 F, Muskegon 67 F.
- Upwelling-favorable wind in the last three days: St. Joseph 15 h, South Haven 11 h, Grand Haven 3 h, Muskegon 2 h.

**Past seasons:** I did not run the earlier-season comparison for this question, so I have no historical pattern to add.

## Caveats

- The newest report is Aug 27, six days old. The conditions tool returned a backtest summary of the week before Sept 2, not live readings, so treat the water and wind figures as last week's.
- Pier reports are sparse: South Haven has one recent pier entry, St. Joseph has none since Aug 6, and the Grand Haven pier entry was not rated.
- The buoys are miles offshore. The satellite pier-water values are closer to shore but are satellite estimates.
- Check the forecast and wind before you go; I have no current wind forecast here.

- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph (Aug 20 report): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3eeac7b
